verdicts.reason: Ordinary jobs skip the branch routes and a heavy base builds on untreated marsh, which is the stated failure.
Hauling uses the routes, marsh refuses heavy building until stilts are done, and both factions move on and off the crown without gates.
Mud slows everyone equally regardless of weight, and there is no self or companion escape.
Sinking scales with weight, held pawns take no injury, and both self-release and companion rescue work.
The gallery destroys an adjacent colony wall, a building and the boughway, which must stay intact.
Reach is the same at every distance; encounter eligibility alone does not show reach scaling with pool size.
A tamed victim gets a deadline, nearby help succeeds and is rewarded, and distant help is uncertain.
The real strike kills immediately with no rescue deadline.
Danger and service change map-wide instead of at the attacked pool, and the grievance does not survive reload.
The list is obtainable through a supported lane, shows a dated snapshot, and reading it leaves danger unchanged.
An ambient whole-body emergence occurs, and it must stay excluded.
Disabling the feature during transit consumes the treatment instead of returning it.
The tank teaches on failed placement, and the fatal hit silently deletes its captive.
The young establishes over several days and is stopped by the right poison at its own pool.
Reload forgives the owed gift and pressure, and a repeated display release pays twice.
After a delay the raiders converge on the bait, and the second front comes from a separate edge.
With RM_Thirst active, the native drinks its home water through a normal thirst job without dehydrating.
Harvest yields oil, the real ignition flashes haze and wakes an eligible pool, and the defeated adult stays quiet.
Both pools have the same fixed effective range; eye eligibility is explicitly separate from reach.
Carrying the victim never clears the active deadline, and the rescued colonist is lost anyway.
Porter service stops at both pools, and danger at the attacked pool does not actually rise.
Bird calls resume while the sentinel hush still holds; a shared hush must silence both sources.
The defeated adult still strikes through the shared shore exposure, so defeat and shared strikes disagree.
Poisoning a different pool stops maturity, but only the right poison at that particular pool may do so.
The repeated display release pays its rewards twice.
The second front enters right beside the first, so there is no real two-front wager.
Teaching happens on the failed placement; only placed production may teach.
The flash wakes water whose adult was permanently defeated, ignoring adult quiet.
